license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person: (a) To practice or offer to practice nursing in this State or use any title, abbreviation, sign, card or device to indicate that he or she is practicing nursing in this State unless that person has been licensed pursuant to the provisions of this chapter

issuing_authority.quote: The Board shall: (a) Adopt regulations establishing reasonable standards ... (b) Prepare and administer examinations for the issuance of a license or certificate under this chapter. (c) Investigate and determine the eligibility of an applicant for a license or certificate under this chapter.

name.quote: The Board shall: (a) Adopt regulations establishing reasonable standards ... (b) Prepare and administer examinations for the issuance of a license or certificate under this chapter.

type.quote: The Board shall: (a) Adopt regulations establishing reasonable standards ... (b) Prepare and administer examinations for the issuance of a license or certificate under this chapter. (c) Investigate and determine the eligibility of an applicant for a license or certificate under this chapter. (d) Carry out and enforce the provisions of this chapter

age_minimum.quote: Is at least 18 years of age.

degree_required.value: Completed a course of study in an accredited school of professional nursing and holds a diploma therefrom
degree_required.quote: Has completed a course of study in: (1) An accredited school of professional nursing and holds a diploma therefrom; or (2) An approved school of professional nursing in the process of obtaining accreditation and holds a diploma therefrom.

accrediting_body.value: nationally recognized association or an agency authorized by law to accredit schools of nursing
accrediting_body.quote: "Accredited school of professional nursing" means a school of professional nursing which is accredited by a nationally recognized association or an agency authorized by law to accredit schools of professional nursing in the state in which the school is located.

degree_level.quote: Has completed a course of study in: (1) An accredited school of professional nursing and holds a diploma therefrom

school_approval_basis.quote: accredited by a nationally recognized association or an agency authorized by law to accredit schools of professional nursing in the state in which the school is located

credential_pegged.quote: Has completed a course of study in: (1) An accredited school of professional nursing and holds a diploma therefrom

tiers.quote: Has completed a course of study in: (1) An accredited school of professional nursing and holds a diploma therefrom
Has a high school diploma or its equivalent as determined by the State Board of Education.

Has completed an educational program designed to prepare a registered nurse to: (I) Perform designated acts of medical diagnosis; (II) Prescribe therapeutic or corrective measures; and (III) Prescribe controlled substances, poisons, dangerous drugs and devices

required.quote: Has completed a course of study in: (1) An accredited school of professional nursing and holds a diploma therefrom

experience_source.quote: every applicant for a license to practice as a professional nurse in the State of Nevada must submit to the Board written evidence under oath that the applicant ... Has completed a course of study in: (1) An accredited school of professional nursing and holds a diploma therefrom

exams.name: Professional Nurse Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Board may supplement with oral or practical examination at its discretion
exams.quote: each applicant who is otherwise qualified for a license to practice nursing as a professional nurse shall be required to write and pass an examination on such subjects and in such form as the Board may from time to time determine.

exams.name: Practical Nurse Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Given not less than once each calendar year
exams.quote: Passes the practical nurses examination, which examination must be given by the Board not less than once each calendar year

exams.name: Nursing Assistant Certification Examination
exams.notes: If applicant fails examination three times, must repeat the training program
exams.jurisdiction: national (uniform national examination authorized by Board)
exams.quote: If an applicant fails the examination three times, the applicant must repeat the training program prescribed in NRS 632.2856.

exams.name: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse National Certification
exams.notes: Certification by American Board of Nursing Specialties, National Commission for Certifying Agencies, or other approved agency; does not apply to APRNs licensed before July 1, 2014
exams.jurisdiction: national (ABNS, NCCA/ICE, or Board-approved national agency)
exams.quote: submits proof that he or she is certified as an advanced practice registered nurse by the American Board of Nursing Specialties, the National Commission for Certifying Agencies of the Institute for Credentialing Excellence, or their successor organizations, or any other nationally recognized certification agency approved by the Board

interval_years.quote: Every nurse licensed under the provisions of this chapter must renew his or her license biennially on a date or according to a schedule of dates prescribed by regulation of the Board.

required.quote: The Board shall not renew any license issued under this chapter until the licensee has submitted proof satisfactory to the Board of completion, during the 2-year period before renewal of the license, of 30 hours in a program of continuing education approved by the Board

hours_per_period.quote: completion, during the 2-year period before renewal of the license, of 30 hours in a program of continuing education approved by the Board

period_years.quote: during the 2-year period before renewal of the license, of 30 hours in a program of continuing education

value: For APRNs: at least 2 hours on suicide prevention and awareness (within 2 years of initial licensure, then at least 2 hours every 4 years)
For all licensees: at least 4 hours on medical consequences of terrorism/weapons of mass destruction (within 2 years of initial licensure)
For all licensees: at least 4 hours on cultural competency and diversity, equity and inclusion (biennially)
For APRNs registered to dispense controlled substances: at least 2 hours on substance use disorders and opioid prescribing each licensure period
For APRNs: at least 2 hours on screening, brief intervention and referral to treatment approach (within 2 years of initial licensure)
For licensees providing/supervising emergency medical services or primary care: at least 2 hours on HIV stigma/discrimination (within 2 years of beginning such services)
topical_requirements.quote: the program of continuing education required by subsection 1 must include: (a) For a person licensed as an advanced practice registered nurse: (1) A course of instruction ... that provides at least 2 hours of instruction on suicide prevention ... (b) For each person licensed pursuant to this chapter, a course of instruction ... relating to the medical consequences of an act of terrorism ... at least 4 hours ... (c) For each person licensed pursuant to this chapter, one or more courses ... that provide at least 4 hours of instruction relating to cultural competency and diversity, equity and inclusion

available.quote: The Board shall, without examination, issue a license to practice nursing as a professional nurse to any applicant who otherwise meets the qualifications required of professional nurses in this State and who has been duly licensed or registered as a registered nurse under the laws of any other jurisdiction after passing an examination required by that jurisdiction

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid and unrestricted license from another jurisdiction with equivalent examination requirements. Expedited license by endorsement also available under NRS 632.161 and 632.162 for general applicants and military/veterans. Board may also enter reciprocal agreements with other states/territories.
requirements.quote: the Board may issue a license by endorsement to practice as a professional nurse to an applicant who meets the requirements set forth in this section. An applicant may submit to the Board an application for such a license if the applicant holds a corresponding valid and unrestricted license to practice as a professional nurse in the District of Columbia or any state or territory of the United States.

exists.quote: The Board shall: (a) Adopt regulations establishing reasonable standards ... (b) Prepare and administer examinations for the issuance of a license or certificate under this chapter. (c) Investigate and determine the eligibility of an applicant for a license or certificate under this chapter. (d) Carry out and enforce the provisions of this chapter

national_certification.value: American Board of Nursing Specialties (ABNS); National Commission for Certifying Agencies of the Institute for Credentialing Excellence (NCCA/ICE)
national_certification.quote: submits proof that he or she is certified as an advanced practice registered nurse by the American Board of Nursing Specialties, the National Commission for Certifying Agencies of the Institute for Credentialing Excellence, or their successor organizations, or any other nationally recognized certification agency approved by the Board

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person: (a) To practice or offer to practice nursing in this State or use any title, abbreviation, sign, card or device to indicate that he or she is practicing nursing in this State unless that person has been licensed pursuant to the provisions of this chapter

credential_type.quote: any person who practices or offers to practice nursing in this State shall submit evidence that he or she is qualified to practice and must be licensed as provided in this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person: (a) To practice or offer to practice nursing in this State or use any title, abbreviation, sign, card or device to indicate that he or she is practicing nursing in this State unless that person has been licensed pursuant to the provisions of this chapter

title_protection.quote: Who does not hold a valid and subsisting license to practice nursing issued pursuant to the provisions of this chapter to practice or offer to practice in this State as a registered nurse, licensed practical nurse, graduate nurse, trained nurse, certified nurse or under any other title or designation suggesting that the person possesses qualifications and skill in the field of nursing.

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person: (a) To practice or offer to practice nursing in this State or use any title, abbreviation, sign, card or device to indicate that he or she is practicing nursing in this State unless that person has been licensed pursuant to the provisions of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license or certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license or certificate pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of any offense involving moral turpitude or related to qualifications/functions/duties of a licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of any offense: (1) Involving moral turpitude; or (2) Related to the qualifications, functions or duties of a licensee or holder of a certificate, in which case the record of conviction is conclusive evidence thereof.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of violating provisions of workers compensation fraud statutes (NRS 616D.200, 616D.220, 616D.240 or 616D.300 to 616D.440)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of violating any of the provisions of NRS 616D.200, 616D.220, 616D.240 or 616D.300 to 616D.440, inclusive.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfit or incompetent by reason of gross negligence or recklessness in carrying out usual nursing functions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unfit or incompetent by reason of gross negligence or recklessness in carrying out usual nursing functions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Uses controlled substance, dangerous drug, or intoxicating liquor in a dangerous manner or to an extent that impairs ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Uses any controlled substance, dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS, or intoxicating liquor to an extent or in a manner which is dangerous or injurious to any other person or which impairs his or her ability to conduct the practice authorized by the license or certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Is a person with mental incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a person with mental incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of unprofessional conduct including practicing medicine without license, impersonation, permitting license use, repeated malpractice, patient abuse, controlled substance conviction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of unprofessional conduct, which includes, but is not limited to, the following: (1) Conviction of practicing medicine without a license ... (2) Impersonating any applicant or acting as proxy ... (3) Impersonating another licensed practitioner ... (4) Permitting or allowing another person to use his or her license ... (5) Repeated malpractice ... (6) Physical, verbal or psychological abuse of a patient. (7) Conviction for the use or unlawful possession of a controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has willfully or repeatedly violated provisions of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has willfully or repeatedly violated the provisions of this chapter. The voluntary surrender of a license or certificate issued pursuant to this chapter is prima facie evidence that the licensee or certificate holder has committed or expects to commit a violation of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of aiding or abetting any person in a violation of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of aiding or abetting any person in a violation of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has falsified an entry on a patient's medical chart concerning a controlled substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has falsified an entry on a patient's medical chart concerning a controlled substance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has falsified information given to physician, pharmacist, podiatric physician or dentist to obtain a controlled substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has falsified information which was given to a physician, pharmacist, podiatric physician or dentist to obtain a controlled substance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has knowingly procured or administered an unapproved controlled substance or dangerous drug not meeting statutory exceptions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has knowingly procured or administered a controlled substance or a dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS that is not approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has been disciplined in another state in connection with a nursing license or has committed acts constituting a violation of this chapter in another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been disciplined in another state in connection with a license to practice nursing or a certificate to practice as a nursing assistant or medication aide - certified, or has committed an act in another state which would constitute a violation of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has engaged in conduct likely to deceive, defraud or endanger a patient or the general public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in conduct likely to deceive, defraud or endanger a patient or the general public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has willfully failed to comply with a regulation, subpoena or order of the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has willfully failed to comply with a regulation, subpoena or order of the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has operated a medical facility during which the license was suspended/revoked or an act resulted in suspension/revocation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has operated a medical facility at any time during which: (1) The license of the facility was suspended or revoked; or (2) An act or omission occurred which resulted in the suspension or revocation of the license pursuant to NRS 449.160.

disciplinary_grounds.description: APRN who has failed to obtain training required by Board pursuant to NRS 632.2375 (opioid/substance use training)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is an advanced practice registered nurse who has failed to obtain any training required by the Board pursuant to NRS 632.2375.

disciplinary_grounds.description: APRN who has failed to comply with controlled substance prescribing laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is an advanced practice registered nurse who has failed to comply with the provisions of NRS 453.163, 453.164, 453.226, 639.23507, 639.23535 and 639.2391 to 639.23916, inclusive, and any regulations adopted by the State Board of Pharmacy pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has engaged in fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering or dispensing of a schedule II, III or IV controlled substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in the fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering or dispensing of a controlled substance listed in schedule II, III or IV.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has violated provisions of NRS 454.217 or 629.086 (injection of controlled substances or dermal fillers)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated the provisions of NRS 454.217 or 629.086.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has performed or supervised the performance of a pelvic examination in violation of NRS 629.085
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has performed or supervised the performance of a pelvic examination in violation of NRS 629.085.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has failed to comply with provisions of NRS 441A.315 or regulations adopted pursuant thereto (communicable disease reporting)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to comply with the provisions of NRS 441A.315 or any regulations adopted pursuant thereto.

insurance_required.quote: The Board may require an advanced practice registered nurse to maintain a policy of professional liability insurance in accordance with regulations adopted by the Board.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of nursing" means the general observation, diagnosis and treatment of changes in a person's health. The term does not include acts of medical diagnosis or prescription of therapeutic or corrective measures, except as authorized by specific statute.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of nursing" means the general observation, diagnosis and treatment of changes in a person's health. The term does not include acts of medical diagnosis or prescription of therapeutic or corrective measures, except as authorized by specific statute.

value: general observation, diagnosis and treatment of changes in a person's health
care and counsel of the ill, injured or infirm
maintenance of health or prevention of illness
supervision and teaching of other personnel
administration of medications and treatments as prescribed by authorized prescribers
prescription of therapeutic or corrective measures (APRN)
prescription of controlled substances, poisons, dangerous drugs and devices (APRN if authorized)
methods_authorized.quote: "Practice of professional nursing" means the performance of any act in the observation, care and counsel of the ill, injured or infirm, in the maintenance of health or prevention of illness of others, in the supervision and teaching of other personnel, in the administration of medications and treatments as prescribed by an advanced practice registered nurse, a licensed physician, a physician assistant ... requiring substantial specialized judgment and skill

drug_authority.value: APRNs authorized pursuant to NRS 639.2351 may prescribe controlled substances, poisons, dangerous drugs and devices; APRNs with at least 2 years or 2,000 hours of clinical experience or with an approved physician protocol may prescribe schedule II controlled substances; CRNAs may order, prescribe, possess and administer controlled substances under physician supervision in critical access hospitals
drug_authority.quote: If authorized pursuant to NRS 639.2351 and subject to the limitations set forth in subsection 3, prescribe controlled substances, poisons, dangerous drugs and devices

license_tiers.quote: "Licensed practical nurse" means a person who is licensed to practice practical nursing as provided in this chapter. ... "Advanced practice registered nurse" means a registered nurse who ... Is licensed by the Board to provide services in addition to those that other registered nurses are authorized to provide. ... "Certified registered nurse anesthetist" means a registered nurse who is certified by the Board pursuant to NRS 632.2395

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" means a registered nurse who: 1. Has specialized skills, knowledge and experience; and 2. Is licensed by the Board to provide services in addition to those that other registered nurses are authorized to provide.

value: physician assistant licensed pursuant to chapter 630 or 633
lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "Practice of practical nursing" means the performance of selected acts in the care of the ill, injured or infirm under the direction of a registered professional nurse, an advanced practice registered nurse, a licensed physician, a physician assistant licensed pursuant to chapter 630 or 633 of NRS, a licensed dentist or a licensed podiatric physician

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse may: (a) Engage in selected medical diagnosis and treatment; (b) Order home health care for a patient; (c) If authorized pursuant to NRS 639.2351 and subject to the limitations set forth in subsection 3, prescribe controlled substances, poisons, dangerous drugs and devices

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse may: (a) Engage in selected medical diagnosis and treatment; (b) Order home health care for a patient; (c) If authorized pursuant to NRS 639.2351 and subject to the limitations set forth in subsection 3, prescribe controlled substances, poisons, dangerous drugs and devices

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: If authorized pursuant to NRS 639.2351 and subject to the limitations set forth in subsection 3, prescribe controlled substances, poisons, dangerous drugs and devices

value: Schedule II (with at least 2 years or 2,000 hours clinical experience, or pursuant to approved physician protocol)
controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse who is authorized to prescribe controlled substances, poisons, dangerous drugs and devices pursuant to NRS 639.2351 shall not prescribe a controlled substance listed in schedule II unless: (a) The advanced practice registered nurse has at least 2 years or 2,000 hours of clinical experience; or (b) The controlled substance is prescribed pursuant to a protocol approved by a collaborating physician.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: APRNs registered to dispense controlled substances must complete at least 2 hours of training on substance use disorders and opioid prescribing each licensure period; schedule II controlled substance prescribing requires 2 years/2,000 hours clinical experience or approved physician protocol
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: The Board shall, by regulation, require each advanced practice registered nurse who is registered to dispense controlled substances pursuant to NRS 453.231 to complete at least 2 hours of training relating specifically to persons with substance use or other addictive disorders and the prescribing of opioids during each period of licensure.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: Any person, except a nursing assistant trainee, who practices or offers to practice as a nursing assistant in this State shall submit evidence that he or she is qualified so to practice and must be certified as provided in this chapter.

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: "Medication aide - certified" means a nursing assistant who is certified by the Board to administer authorized medications in designated facilities.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: "Basic nursing services" means the performance of acts designated by the Board which are within the practice of nursing under the direction of a registered nurse or a licensed practical nurse that do not require the substantial specialized skill, judgment and knowledge required of a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse.

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: The following persons shall report in writing to the Executive Director of the Board any conduct of a licensee or holder of a certificate which constitutes a violation of the provisions of this chapter: ... (b) Any personnel of a medical facility or facility for the dependent engaged in the admission, examination, care or treatment of persons or an administrator, manager or other person in charge of a medical facility or facility for the dependent upon notification by a member of the staff of the facility.

rn_death_pronouncement_authorized.quote: A registered nurse who is authorized by a physician or advanced practice registered nurse pursuant to NRS 440.415 may make a pronouncement of death.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: An advanced practice registered nurse may perform acts of medical diagnosis and treatment, home health care orders, and controlled substance prescribing by using equipment that transfers information electronically, telephonically or by fiber optics, including through telehealth, from within or outside this State or the United States.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse may perform the acts described in paragraphs (a), (b) and (c) of subsection 2 by using equipment that transfers information concerning the medical condition of a patient in this State electronically, telephonically or by fiber optics, including, without limitation, through telehealth, as defined in NRS 629.515, from within or outside this State or the United States.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: Under the supervision of a physician licensed pursuant to chapter 630 or 633 of NRS, order, prescribe, possess and administer controlled substances, poisons, dangerous drugs and devices to treat a patient under the care of a licensed physician in a critical access hospital in preparation for surgery or childbirth, during surgery or childbirth and while a patient recovers from surgery or childbirth.

nursing_education_program_clinical_hours.quote: The training program required for certification as a nursing assistant must consist of 75 hours of instruction. The program must include no less than 60 hours of theory and learning skills in a laboratory setting.
